title: Red Nichols in the Glen Gray band and O'Keefe
summary: Red Nichols joined Gray's band after leaving factory work during the war, with manager O'Keefe a neighbor from the 1920s.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Well, yeah, you know. Red Nichols was in the band for a while. This was after the war. And Red comes out of a factory. He'd been working in a factory, and during the war he had done that kind of work, you know, for
his draft service or something like that, and he'd gone out of the business for a couple of years.
So O'Keefe, the manager, he's come to me, and he said -- we both knew that we -- all three of us lived in the same building during the '20s.
I'm talking now about O'Keefe and --
